summary: The Food and Drug Administration granted de novo authorization to Virtuoso Surgical’s robotic system for endoscopic surgery to remove bladder tumors, the company said Tuesday. In Virtuoso’s procedure, lesions are removed in one piece in an approach called en bloc resection to obtain tissue for diagnosis of bladder cancer. Two miniaturized robotic arms at the tip of a standard-sized endoscope operate through the urethra, without incisions. The robot, which received breakthrough device designation in September 2025, is the first device in a new FDA classification for electromechanical surgical systems used in endoluminal procedures, where instruments pass through an endoscope into the body.
